links.outcome: Presence of source references and accuracy of citations in LLM dental answers
links.effect: All models occasionally exhibited inaccuracies, generality, outdated content, and a lack of source references; ChatGPT-4 outperformed ChatGPT-3.5 (P=.008), Bing Chat (P=.049), and Bard (P=.045).
links.quote: Although ChatGPT-4 statistically outperformed ChatGPT-3.5 (P=.008), Bing Chat (P=.049), and Bard (P=.045), all models occasionally exhibited inaccuracies, generality, outdated content, and a lack of source references.

links.outcome: Accuracy, completeness, and currency of LLM dental clinical knowledge versus guidelines
links.effect: LLMs delivered irrelevant, vague, outdated, or not fully accurate information against guideline-based rubric; ChatGPT-4 scored best.
links.quote: The evaluators noted instances where the LLMs delivered irrelevant information, vague answers, or information that was not fully accurate.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance of commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-4, Bard, Bing Chat) on 20 dental clinical questions, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
